steps.eval: (() => { const touch = matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches; const frame = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((iframe) => iframe.src.includes('addtorrent.html')); const doc = frame.contentDocument; const selectable = (el) => doc.defaultView.getComputedStyle(el).userSelect !== 'none'; const browserMenu = (el) => { const event = new doc.defaultView.MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); el.dispatchEvent(event); return !event.defaultPrevented; }; const label = doc.querySelector('label[for=savepath]') ?? doc.querySelector('label'); const field = doc.getElementById('savepath') ?? doc.querySelector('input[type=text]'); const result = { labelText: selectable(label), fieldText: selectable(field), infoHashText: selectable(doc.getElementById('infoHashV1')), labelBrowserMenu: browserMenu(label), fieldBrowserMenu: browserMenu(field) }; const expected = { labelText: !touch, fieldText: true, infoHashText: true, labelBrowserMenu: !touch, fieldBrowserMenu: true }; const wrong = Object.keys(expected).filter((key) => result[key] !== expected[key]); if (wrong.length > 0) throw new Error(`unexpected: ${wrong.join(', ')}`); return result; })()

(() => { const doc = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((iframe) => iframe.src.includes('addtorrent.html')).contentDocument; const column = doc.querySelector('.column').getBoundingClientRect(); const outside = [...doc.querySelectorAll('.column:first-child :is(fieldset, table, input, select, textarea)')].filter((el) => (el.offsetWidth > 0) && (el.getBoundingClientRect().right > column.right + 0.5)).map((el) => `${el.tagName}#${el.id}`); if (outside.length > 0) throw new Error(`wider than their column: ${outside.join(', ')}`); return `everything fits the ${Math.round(column.width)}px column`; })()
